args.title: Prevent CSV rows with same date/amount/description but different currencies from merging
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The `writeCsv` function currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, causing rows with different currencies to be lost in the exported CSV. This happens because the `toDelimited` function (imported from `../exportUtils`) likely deduplicates rows based on these fields without considering currency. The fix should ensure that rows with distinct currencies are treated as separate entries, even if they share other fields.

args.title: Prevent CSV rows with same date/amount/description but different currencies from merging
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The `writeCsv` function currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, causing rows with different currencies to be lost in the exported CSV. This happens because the `toDelimited` function (imported from `../exportUtils`) likely deduplicates rows based on these fields without considering currency. The fix should ensure that rows with distinct currencies are treated as separate entries, even if they share other fields.
